ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。

- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › TTC 毫米波測試量能線索
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）介紹[[電信技術中心]]毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 可支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

同一來源另描述[[電信技術中心]]提供電信設備審驗認證服務，並協助研擬電信技術標準規範。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

passages.text:
Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源指出 smartphone Art 3.3g / [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] / E112 是沒有 ETSI EN standard 的 regulatory compliance requirement；當沒有 EN standard available 時需 Notified body involved，並稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。
- [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]部分列出 [[47 CFR]]、[[ANSI C63.26]]、[[ANSI C63.10]]、[[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]、[[C63.19]] 等測試依據，並列出 licensed cellular CFR47 test items：RF power output、modulation characteristics、occupied bandwidth、band edge、spurious emissions、frequency stability、peak to average ratio、field strength of spurious radiation。
- 來源以 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 [[47 CFR §2.1057]] 對照 CE RED / FCC 的 frequency range：5G NR FR1 的 CE RED 30 MHz–26 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–40 GHz；5G NR FR2 的 CE RED 30 MHz–90 GHz、FCC 9 kHz–200 GHz；並提到 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。
- [[NTN 裝置法規測試]]部分把 NTN device implementation 分成 proprietary、3GPP < R16、3GPP R17 NTN-IoT、reuse spectrum assets / 3GPP unmodified UE 等路徑，例子包含 iPhone 14 / Globalstar、Qualcomm / Iridium、MTK / Bullitt / Skylo、AT&T / AST Space Mobile、T-Mobile / Starlink、Optus / Lynk。
- 來源列出衛星 / NTN 相關 EN standards：[[EN 301 441]]、[[EN 301 442]]、[[EN 301 444]]、[[EN 301 681]]、[[EN 302 574]]、[[EN 303 981]]，並將 iPhone14、Bullitt defy satellite link、StarLink Dish 作為 DoC / market product examples。
- 來源將 [[EN 301 681]] 測試偏向 conducted measurement，列出 spectrum analyzer、signal generator、BER measure / system emulator / mobile radio tester 等 required instruments，並明示 latest [[R&S CMW500]] software can support 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling。

衛星地球電臺設備技術規範 › 來源中的名詞定義
來源說規範名詞定義及縮寫依據 [[FCC Part 25.103]]，並列出：

- 衛星地球電臺 / Earth Station：在地球上與衛星系統間進行無線電信號接收、處理、發射之電信設備，設備包括射頻設備及天線。
- [[FSS]] / Fixed-Satellite Service：特定位置之衛星地球電臺與一個或多個衛星間之無線電通信，該特定位置得為指定之固定地點或指定區域內之任何固定地點。
- Fixed Earth Station：設置於地球上固定地點，與衛星系統進行通信之衛星地球電臺。
- [[ESIM]] / Earth Station in Motion：來源前段說當 FSS 地球電臺用於 ESAA、ESV、VMES 三種載具上即為 ESIM；但定義段落 2.4 寫為設置於地球上指定區域內之任何固定地點，需另行對照正式草案。
- [[ESAA]]：於航空器上操作之衛星地球電臺，可與 FSS 太空站進行通信。
- [[ESV]]：於船舶在水上航行用之衛星地球電臺，可與 FSS 太空站進行通信。
- [[VMES]]：主要操作在陸地行駛機動車輛之衛星地球電臺，可與 FSS 太空站進行通信。
- [[NCMC]]：具遠端控制衛星地球電臺操作之設施，且其操作為衛星網路或系統之一部分。
- [[GSO]] 衛星：環狀順行軌道位於地球赤道平面，且相對於地球維持在固定位置之衛星。
- [[NGSO]] 衛星：位於地球表面高度一定範圍內之軌道，且不維持在固定位置，並沿著地表移動之衛星。
- Ku / Conventional Ku / Extended Ku / Conventional Ka 頻段：來源列出多個上行 / 下行頻段定義。
- 地平線仰角、到達角、[[離軸角]]。

O-RU testing › R&S portfolio for O-RU testing
- Slide 21 說 isolated testing is not described in `O-RAN.WG4.3GPP-Conformance-Testing-TR-v00.12`，且 isolated setup cannot replace pair-wise testing for 3GPP tests。
- Slide 21 說 TX characteristics in isolated testing of an O-RU seems feasible；RX characteristics in isolated O-RU testing has several challenges；RX performance only pairwise testing is possible。
- Slide 26 說 3GPP receiver characteristic testing requires throughput calculation，VSE 已實作 BLER 與 Tput parameters，並把 isolated O-RU receiver testing 定位為 pre-conformance use case。
- Slide 33 說 O-RAN.WG4.CONF 多數測試 single antenna port at a time；one port analyzer and generator configuration is sufficient。MIMO testing typically done for receiver performance；MIMO transmitter tests are not defined by 3GPP for infrastructure；beamforming tests require magnitude and phase relations between antenna ports。
- Slide 35–38 說 VSE-K175 支援 O-RAN measurements，SMW-K175 支援 U-Plane generation，O-RAN PCAP Converter 可把 captured Ethernet stream 轉為 VSE file format，供 VSE 分析 UL / DL U-Plane data。
- Slide 40–44 建立 [[O-RAN Beamforming Measurements]] 線索：至少 2 connectors to DUT、sequential measurement allowed、TER 需 extract / calculate weights、mag/phase relation or beam direction；DL / UL setup 使用 [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S OSP]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 PCAP capture。
- Slide 46–48 給出 O-RAN 5G FR1、O-RAN 5G FR1 incl. BF tests、O-RAN 5G FR1 + 3GPP Conformance Ch. 6/7 與 Upgrade to FR2 的 typical / detailed configuration。

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers
[[Network Infrastructure T&M drivers]] 是 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]] 用來整理 mobile network infrastructure 產業趨勢與對應 test and measurement solution 的 sales / solution-level 框架。

- 本頁是簡報摘要，不是正式產品 roadmap、datasheet、quote configuration 或 standards compliance statement。
- 來源多處為圖像 / 產品組合 slide，markitdown 轉檔可能遺失圖片中細節。

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

R&S PCB test solutions › 未決事項
- Slide 21 未標示 R&S PCB test solutions 的正式文件版次與產品 portfolio 對應。
- Slide 21 未標示 [[TDR]]、[[Delta-L]]、ISD/ADK、DK/DF extraction 的標準版本、演算法、測試條件或工具型號。
- Slide 21 未展開 PL、ISD、ADK、RSTW、SWISSTO12、QWED、KEYCOM。
- 需回看原始 PPTX 圖像確認各圖示、商標、箭頭與工具對應關係。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

R&S PCB test solutions › 相關來源

NTN test and measurement aspects › Mobile network testing（MNT）
來源指出 [[Mobile network testing]] 可擴展至 NTN：

- passive testing：scanner 監測 downlink spectrum，不建立連線。
- active testing：test UE / QualiPoc Android 做 connected mode / E2E QoS / QoE testing。
- NTN MNT metrics 包含 RSRP、RSRQ、RS-SINR、RSSI、spectrum clearance、RTT、packet loss、BLER、throughput、mobility、random access success、SIB decoding、SMS / voice / video QoE。
- DTC LEO 與 Skylo IoT-NTN drive test examples 被作為 MNT early scenarios。

NTN test and measurement aspects
[[NTN test and measurement aspects]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 NTN device、satellite、SAN、payload、phased array antenna、network 與 production testing 的總覽，涵蓋 RF、protocol、RRM、LBS、conformance、OTA、field testing 與 software-assisted testing。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Conformance / certification testing
來源描述 certification ecosystem 包含 certification organization、neutral test house、test equipment vendor、network operator / equipment vendor。

- NTN NB-IoT certification program 已於 late 2024 launched，聚焦 n255 / n256。
- conformance tests 在 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]] 與 [[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]] umbrella 下定義。
- 來源說 GCF WI-555 描述 124 個 NTN conformance testing 相關 test cases。
- early 2026 狀態：IoT_NTN test cases 約 174；GSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 58 / 6 / 46，NGSO RF TRX / Performance / RRM 為 56 / 8 / 0。
- 目前狀態另列 NR-NTN testing 約 RRM 93、RF 38、protocol 22 test cases。
- 2025 年 GCF 擴展 certification program，納入 NR-NTN 與 DTC certification testing。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 台灣 NCC 認證流程線索
[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：

1. 準備：文件、樣品、電路圖、天線規格。

3. 實驗室測試：[[TAF]] 認可實驗室進行 RF / EMC 測試，來源標示 3–4 週。
4. 審核與核發：報告審查、證書核發，來源標示證書 5 年有效。

### Short answer
The vault does not provide a formal ranking, but the best-supported VNA opportunities are: higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G infrastructure, LEO / NTN satellite user terminals and phased-array OTA, wireless regulatory / test-house market access, and high-frequency PCB / SI validation for wireless and satellite supply chains; O-RAN / beamforming is a qualified opportunity because the vault supports the measurement need but not a full VNA product-to-use-case mapping.[10][11][28][43][58][79]
### Recommended first-sell opportunities
| Opportunity | Evidence for demand or measurement need | VNA evidence | R&S product / option evidence | Evidence gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G network infrastructure | Network infrastructure drivers include “More Spectrum Bands / Higher Frequencies / Expanding Bandwidth,” and the solution mapping for higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G explicitly lists R&S ZNA, R&S ZNA67EXT, mmWave front ends, and frequency converters.[10][11] | This is the clearest direct VNA opportunity because the solution mapping explicitly places R&S ZNA and R&S ZNA67EXT in the higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G bucket.[11] | R&S ZNA covers 10 MHz to 67 GHz depending on model, supports mmWave converters via optional rear-panel LO out, and R&S ZNA67EXT is described as a 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System with 10 MHz to 110 GHz measurement range.[1][61][69] | The network infrastructure source is a sales / solution-level framework, not a formal product roadmap, datasheet, quote configuration, or standards compliance statement.[76] |
| LEO / NTN satellite user terminals, phased-array antennas, and OTA validation | The LEO supply chain is described as including ground equipment and user terminals whose core is phased-array antennas and RF front-end, plus system integration and test verification.[58] | Kuiper UT OTA chamber configuration explicitly lists VNA and signal analyzer as core equipment, with calibration steps such as background subtraction, element A/P calibration, and beam table generation.[43] | R&S ZNA includes direct IF access for mmWave converters and antenna measurement systems, mmWave converter support, phase-coherent source control, and RFFE GPIO interface options.[4][61][65] | The Kuiper UT material is a company-restricted presentation, not a formal test plan, certification requirement, or source with measurement uncertainty.[45][48] |
| Wireless regulatory labs and market-access testing | Wireless products require regulatory compliance, industry certification, and operator acceptance testing, and regulatory compliance is described as necessary for regional legal market access.[29] | The regulatory test source lists network analyzer as one of the primary test-instrument categories for wireless regulatory test labs.[28] | The vault confirms R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer series up to 67 GHz, but it does not directly map a specific ZNA model or option stack to the regulatory-lab use case.[5][69] | The regulatory-test source has unresolved issues: standards versions, setup details, supported standard lists, option stacks, and formal product datasheets are not provided.[96] |
| High-frequency PCB / material / SI validation for wireless and satellite supply chains | The LEO satellite supply chain includes high-frequency PCB and RF components, and the Taiwan wireless report also positions LEO supply chain growth alongside Wi‑Fi 7 ODM / OEM growth.[9][58] | R&S PCB test solutions list material measurement, stackup selection, signal-integrity modeling/testing, sampling testing, and process monitoring, with items such as impedance, Dk/Df extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, TDR, and Delta-L.[79] | R&S ZNA software options include R&S ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization, and ZNA also lists time-domain analysis, deembedding, and measurement options relevant to network-analysis workflows.[63][65] | The PCB test source does not provide formal R&S product model mapping, option code requirements beyond the separate ZNA option list, test frequency, standards, fixture, or calibration method.[80] |
| O-RAN / beamforming / Massive MIMO validation | Network infrastructure drivers include MIMO / Beamforming, and O-RAN beamforming measurements require magnitude, phase, time relations, beam weights, or beam direction across antenna ports.[10][55][57] | The solution mapping for Beamforming / Massive MIMO lists R&S ZNBT, while the O-RAN source states beamforming tests require magnitude and phase relations between antenna ports.[11][55] | R&S ZNA 4-port instruments can have up to four independently configurable, phase-coherent, phase-controlled sources and eight true receivers with no multiplexing.[61] | The provided passages do not state R&S ZNBT specifications or explicitly state that ZNA is the O-RAN beamforming solution, so this remains a qualified opportunity rather than a confirmed product fit.[11][55][61] |
### Product and option fit table
| Product line | Demand it can connect to | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it fits the opportunity | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G, satellite UT antenna systems, and PCB characterization opportunities.[11][43][79] | Frequency range up to 67 GHz; 2-port or 4-port base units; optional mmWave converter LO; direct IF access for mmWave converter and antenna measurement systems; R&S ZNA-K8 mmWave converter support; R&S ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization; R&S ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface.[4][61][65][69] | The same product line has cited support for high-frequency coverage, mmWave converter workflows, antenna measurement-system IF access, PCB characterization, and RFFE / GPIO control.[4][61][65][69] | ZNA is directly named in higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G solution mapping, and its specifications list the relevant frequency, converter, IF, PCB, and RFFE capabilities.[11][61][65][69] | The vault does not provide a formal quote configuration, calibration accessory list, or standards-specific compliance statement for these wireless scenarios.[62][76] |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | Higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G opportunities.[11] | R&S ZNA67EXT is described as a 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System with 10 MHz to 110 GHz measurement range.[1] | It is directly connected in the vault to the higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G solution mapping and extends beyond the 67 GHz ZNA base VNA range.[1][11] | The vault states both the 10 MHz to 110 GHz range and the solution-map placement for higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G.[1][11] | The provided passages do not include full ZNA67EXT specifications, option stack, ordering details, or calibration configuration.[1][12] |
| R&S ZNB3000 / ZNB3032 / ZNB3044 | Potential lower-to-mid-frequency VNA coverage for wireless component, PCB, or lab work, but no passage directly maps these models to a wireless opportunity.[32][36][39] | ZNB3000 base units cover 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz, 20 GHz, 32 GHz, or 43.5 GHz depending on model, and ZNB3032 / ZNB3044 pages list 32 GHz and 43.5 GHz model coverage with upgrade notes.[32][36][39] | The evidence supports frequency coverage only; it does not support a direct market-fit claim for wireless communications.[32][36][39] | ZNB3000 model frequencies are documented in the specifications-derived pages.[32][33] | The vault does not tie ZNB3000, ZNB3032, or ZNB3044 to Wi‑Fi, 5G, NTN, regulatory labs, or phased-array testing in the provided passages.[32][36][39] |
| R&S ZNL | Potential entry VNA coverage up to 20 GHz, but no passage directly maps ZNL to a wireless opportunity.[41] | ZNL models cover 5 kHz to 3 GHz, 4.5 GHz, 6 GHz, 14 GHz, or 20 GHz depending on model; common specs include 50 Ω impedance, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace, and 1 Hz to 500 kHz measurement bandwidth.[41] | The evidence supports model coverage and common VNA specifications only, not a confirmed wireless-market fit.[41] | ZNL model overview and document basis are available in the vault.[41][42] | The vault does not connect ZNL to Wi‑Fi 7, 5G, NTN, regulatory testing, or phased-array OTA in the provided passages.[41][42] |
### Scenario entry suggestions
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Entry focus | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| mmWave / early 6G infrastructure R&D | R&S ZNA or R&S ZNA67EXT with mmWave converter support, where the required frequency range determines whether 67 GHz or 110 GHz evidence is relevant.[1][11][61] | Lead with the direct solution-map evidence: higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G explicitly lists R&S ZNA, R&S ZNA67EXT, mmWave front ends, and frequency converters.[11] | Formal configuration, converter models, calibration accessories, and standards compliance are not established by the solution-level source.[76] |
| LEO / NTN user-terminal antenna and RF validation | R&S ZNA with antenna-measurement-related direct IF access, mmWave converter support, and RFFE GPIO where DUT control is needed.[4][61][65] | Lead with the UT / phased-array need and the Kuiper OTA chamber evidence that names VNA as core equipment.[43][58] | Kuiper UT material is not a formal test plan and does not provide uncertainty, instrument model, or calibration standard.[43][45] |
| Wireless regulatory / certification labs | Network analyzer category, with R&S ZNA considered only after frequency range and test-standard needs are confirmed.[28][69] | Lead with the regulatory source that names network analyzer as a primary instrument category for wireless regulatory test labs.[28] | The vault does not give a ZNA-specific regulatory test configuration or supported-standard list.[28][96] |
| High-frequency PCB and SI validation for wireless / LEO supply chain | R&S ZNA with R&S ZNA-K231 Delta-L PCB characterization and relevant deembedding / time-domain options from the ZNA option list.[63][65] | Lead with the PCB flow evidence: impedance, Dk/Df, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, TDR, and Delta-L are listed in R&S PCB test solutions.[79] | The PCB source does not provide product models, test standards, fixture, frequency, or calibration method.[80] |
| O-RAN / beamforming pre-validation | Treat as a qualified lead involving multiport phase / magnitude measurements; do not claim a confirmed ZNA O-RAN solution from current passages.[55][57][61] | Lead with the measurement need: beamforming tests require magnitude and phase relations between antenna ports, and O-RAN beamforming measurements involve antenna-port relations and beam weights / direction.[55][57] | The current passages map R&S ZNBT to Beamforming / Massive MIMO but do not provide ZNBT specs or a formal ZNA-to-O-RAN beamforming mapping.[11][55] |
### Limits
The Wi‑Fi 7 market is documented as a 2026 Taiwanese ODM / OEM growth theme with 320 MHz, 4096-QAM, MLO, 6 GHz, and thermal design, but the provided passages do not directly map VNA products to Wi‑Fi 7 device or certification workflows.[7][9]

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。
